data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): Name 3 distinct tests explicitly: (1) test_dangling_jira_ref_emits_inbound_conflict — Given jira_state issue references dso_local_id=ZZZ with no matching local; When diff called; Then exactly one (inbound, conflict, target=jira_key) with provenance naming ZZZ. (2) test_duplicate_dso_local_id_emits_inbound_conflict_per_collision — Given jira_state with two issues both having dso_local_id=X; When diff called; Then exactly two (inbound, conflict) Mutations with distinct jira_keys. (3) test_ambiguous_local_binding_emits_outbound_probe — Given local_state with ticket whose binding is ambiguous; When diff called; Then (outbound, probe) Mutation emitted. Add conflict-vs-probe definition to differ.py docstring: 'conflict = Jira-side anomaly (dangling ref, duplicate dso_local_id); probe = local-side ambiguity (local ticket cannot be deterministically bound to a single Jira issue, triggering probe action to resolve binding).'
